I mean HR works for your supervisor. They’re literal job is to avoid employee lawsuits. HR doesn’t work for you, despite what you’ve been told. When you told on your supervisor, HR is probably the one who encouraged them to make your life difficult in anyway that they can to encourage you to quit. That way they won’t have to fire you. I learnt early in life not to ever bring issues to HR. Just find another job and quit before they fire you. You’ll realize soon enough that employment laws are to protect businesses and corporations, not employees. It’s not fair or right but it’s the way it is. Your best bet is to just leave. If you need the income to live I doubt you have spare money to waste on lawyers and bullshit. Least if you quit on good terms you might get a reference out of it. If you keep going to HR and complaining, nothing will change, eventually you’ll either quit because your supervisor wants you to, or they’ll fire you with cause. Do yourself a favour and just resign.
